# AstryxClickableCard { #anylumino.AstryxClickableCard }

```python
AstryxClickableCard(
    children=None,
    *,
    label,
    variant='default',
    callbacks=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render an Astryx card that behaves like an action target.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default     |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| children  | ChildInput                                                | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`      |
| label     | str                                                       | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | _required_  |
| variant   | str                                                       | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `'default'` |
| callbacks | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks invoked for frontend activations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`      |
| **props   | Any                                                       | JSON-safe ClickableCard props. Useful keys: href, target, isDisabled, padding, width, height, maxWidth, className, and style. anylumino manages label, variant, child content, and click callbacks. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ClickableCard>. | `{}`        |
